themes.name: Aquarium
themes.author: Voltage
themes.description: Deep teal water: bubbles rising, light ripples playing over the round cover, the controls on the sand at the bottom.

themes.name: Aurora
themes.author: Voltage
themes.description: Northern lights in the album's colours over a black sky, a different sky for every song, swaying with the music. The player floats at the bottom so the sky has the window. Needs the "Aurora sky" plugin for the lights (graphics card, 30 fps while playing).

themes.name: Big & Clear
themes.author: Voltage
themes.description: Large, clear and calm: big text in a font made for legibility, big buttons, contrast above 7:1, no blur and no motion. The player first, the list below.

themes.name: Blueprint
themes.author: Voltage
themes.description: A drafting sheet: blue grid paper, white lines, the cover as the drawing with a dimension line, a title block in the corner.

themes.name: Cassette
themes.author: Voltage
themes.description: An 80s tape deck: the cover on the cassette label with two reels turning in its window, the queue as a hand-written J-card, chunky piano-key buttons.

themes.name: Cinema
themes.author: Voltage
themes.description: A cinema: the cover (or the music video) on a big screen between black bars, the lyrics as subtitles, a title card when a song starts and THE END when it finishes; pages fade through black.

themes.name: Comic
themes.author: Voltage
themes.description: A comic page: ink-bordered panels, halftone dots, the lyrics as speech bubbles, a lettered title and a POW! on every like.

themes.name: CRT green
themes.author: Voltage
themes.description: Green phosphor on a curved tube: vignette, scanlines, a faint flicker, terse tab names and relay clicks.

themes.name: Deep Space
themes.author: Voltage
themes.description: A slow starfield, the cover as a planet inside an orbit ring with a moon, HUD lettering; the list docked on the right.

themes.name: Departures
themes.author: Voltage
themes.description: A station departures board: the title flips in on split-flap tiles, the queue is the list of departures with the clock time each song leaves (with the "Departures board" plugin), the playing one is boarding, played ones have departed.

themes.name: E-ink
themes.author: Voltage
themes.description: Grey on paper like an e-reader: a page header with a small cover, the list as the page. No animation, no blur, no glow.

themes.name: Frosted light
themes.author: Voltage
themes.description: Frosted glass in light or dark, following Windows' setting; a red accent, a big cover, the player as a bar.

themes.name: Beat pulse
themes.author: Voltage
themes.description: The window's edge glows with the beat (at most 3 pulses a second, softer with Reduce flashing).

themes.name: Film grain
themes.author: Voltage
themes.description: A soft film grain and vignette over any theme. Still (no animation): costs almost nothing.

themes.name: Snow
themes.author: Voltage
themes.description: Slow snowfall over any theme. Pauses with the music.

themes.name: Handheld
themes.author: Voltage
themes.description: A pocket console look in four greens: everything on a dot-matrix screen in a pixel font, round A / B buttons, the mini player as the whole device. No console branding.

themes.name: Jackpot
themes.author: Voltage
themes.description: A video slot: a 5 x 3 symbol screen (or 3 x 3) with the cover in the middle, reels that spin on every new song, a lever that skips, bulbs that flash with the beat, coins on a winning line and BIG WIN when you like a song.

themes.name: JRPG
themes.author: Voltage
themes.description: A turn-based battle: the song is the enemy and its HP is the time left. A wild artist appears, FIGHT plays, RUN skips; with the "JRPG battle" plugin seeking hits for damage and you level up as you listen. GAME OVER in the mini player when you die in a match.

themes.name: Messenger
themes.author: Voltage
themes.description: The song as a chat with the artist: lyrics arrive as message bubbles while they are sung (click one to jump there), "typing…" before the next song, the queue as your chat list and the player as the message box.

themes.name: Neon Sign
themes.author: Voltage
themes.description: The song's title as a neon sign on a brick wall: its letters buzz on one by one with every new song, the glow swells with the beat and one tube flickers now and then (never with Reduce flashing). The queue is the bar menu.

themes.name: Night City
themes.author: Voltage
themes.description: Rain over neon: a magenta / cyan sign with the song title, rain streaks across the window, a glitch on every track change. The list as a lit shopfront.

themes.name: Paper
themes.author: Voltage
themes.description: Black ink on newsprint: a blackletter masthead, big serif headlines, halftone covers, ruled columns. No glass, no glow.

themes.name: Pastel goth
themes.author: Voltage
themes.description: Pink and lilac on black, a rounded font, round covers, little bats, stars and bows around the window.

themes.name: Retro Desktop
themes.author: Voltage
themes.description: Late-90s desktop windows: grey bevels, blue title bars on every panel, a teal desktop, the title bar as a taskbar along the bottom.

themes.name: Halloween
themes.author: Voltage
themes.description: A small seasonal theme: pumpkin orange on black, a little moon and drifting fog. Voltage underneath (the example of how small a theme can be).

themes.name: Winter
themes.author: Voltage
themes.description: A small seasonal theme: icy blue on deep navy and slow snowfall. Voltage underneath (the example of how small a theme can be).

themes.name: Sidebar
themes.author: Voltage
themes.description: Search and tabs down the left, the song list as a table in the middle, art and the player in a bar along the bottom.

themes.name: Spreadsheet
themes.author: Voltage
themes.description: Stealth mode: a plain-looking sheet. The controls in a toolbar, the song in the formula bar, numbered rows, a status bar.

themes.name: Studio
themes.author: Voltage
themes.description: A mixing desk: two VU meters whose needles move with the music (with the VU meter plugin), a rack-mounted player, the queue as a channel list.

themes.name: Sumi Ink
themes.author: Voltage
themes.description: Watery black ink on washi: lyrics written down a hanging scroll, the cover in a brushed enso, ink-wash mountains, a red hanko seal.

themes.name: Tactical
themes.author: Voltage
themes.description: A gamer HUD: olive and amber, corner brackets on every panel, a stencil font, a compass-tape progress bar, the mini player as a HUD strip.

themes.name: Terminal
themes.author: Voltage
themes.description: A text-only UI: a pixel font, square corners, no glass or glow, ASCII progress, command-style labels.

themes.name: Vinyl Lounge
themes.author: Voltage
themes.description: Walnut and brass: the cover as a spinning record on a turntable, a tonearm that swings in on play and out on pause, the queue as a record crate.

themes.name: Voltage (starter)
themes.author: Voltage
themes.description: Voltage's own look with every value written out: copy this folder to start a theme.

themes.name: Word Rain
themes.author: Voltage
themes.description: The lyrics rain down: every sung word falls behind the player and piles up at the bottom of the window; a new song sweeps the pile away. Needs the "Word rain" plugin and synced lyrics.
